text:
Someone shouted:

Long live freedom!

and blood answered.


Someone shouted:

Death to the tyrant!,

and blood answered.


Tomorrow, blood will shout:

Long live freedom!

Death to the tyrant!,

and the people

will answer!

translation.title: Someone Shouted
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps Soler's call-and-response structure, where blood first answers and then becomes the revolutionary voice.
